members.name: items
members.doc: The levels of the path, from the top of the hierarchy down to the current page. The last item is the current page.

members.name: onNavigate
members.doc: Reports the item a person navigates to, unless it is disabled.

types.name: BreadcrumbItem

members.name: id
members.doc: Identifies the item. An item without one is identified by its position.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the level is called, such as the name of its page.

members.name: href
members.doc: Where the level leads. An item without one, and the last item, render as text.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Makes the level text that cannot be navigated to.
